The origin of the Mac #TIL

September 8, 2015 · melmeric · Technology

##TIL #apple #factoid #Mac #origin

Apple Inc. employee Jef Raskin named the Macintosh line of personal computers after the McIntosh. He deliberately misspelled the name to avoid conflict with the hi-fi equipment manufacturer McIntosh Laboratory. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/McIntosh_(apple)
